import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        int[] prefixSums = new int[51];
        prefixSums[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i < 51; i++) {
            prefixSums[i] = prefixSums[i - 1] + (1 << i);
        }

        int h = scanner.nextInt();
        int n = scanner.nextInt();

        n = n + prefixSums[h - 1];
        int[] sequenceList = new int[1000]; // large enough to hold sequence
        int seqIndex = 0;
        sequenceList[seqIndex++] = n;

        while (n > 1) {
            n /= 2;
            sequenceList[seqIndex++] = n;
        }

        int steps = 0;
        int currentNode = 1;
        boolean flipState = false;
        int sequenceLength = seqIndex;

        while (currentNode != sequenceList[0]) {
            int[] tempSequence = new int[h + 1];
            int tempValue = currentNode;
            for (int i = 0; i < h; i++) {
                tempSequence[i] = tempValue;
                if (!flipState) {
                    tempValue *= 2;
                } else {
                    tempValue = tempValue * 2 + 1;
                }
                flipState = !flipState;
            }
            if (tempValue == sequenceList[0]) {
                steps += h;
                break;
            }
            tempSequence[h] = tempValue;
            // reverse tempSequence
            for (int i = 0; i < h / 2; i++) {
                int tmp = tempSequence[i];
                tempSequence[i] = tempSequence[h - 1 - i];
                tempSequence[h - 1 - i] = tmp;
            }
            boolean breakOuter = false;
            for (int i = 1; i <= h; i++) {
                if (sequenceList[i] == tempSequence[i - 1]) {
                    steps += prefixSums[i - 1] + h - i + 1;
                    h = i - 1;
                    currentNode = tempSequence[i - 1];
                    if (currentNode == tempSequence[i - 1] * 2) {
                        currentNode = tempSequence[i - 1] * 2 + 1;
                        flipState = false;
                    } else {
                        currentNode = tempSequence[i - 1] * 2;
                        flipState = true;
                    }
                    breakOuter = true;
                    break;
                }
            }
            if (breakOuter) {
                continue;
            }
        }
        System.out.println(steps);
        scanner.close();
    }
}
